title: 第21章 父子情深第22章 父亲请用药
slug: 开局被退婚反手娶小姨子
lines: “初阳，这一次是怎么回事？为何商家的人都来了？”
陈渊问道：“商应年那个老匹夫都来找你麻烦，你是不是做了什么事情？”
收到这个消息的时候，陈渊想到了很多种可能，最后都指向了商红雪，只有商红雪出事了，商应年那个老家伙才会动手，而他们所看到的情况相反，暴躁的是商红尘，而不是商应年。
商应年和陈初阳之间发生了什么，他们不清楚，来到的时候，这两人已经是朋友一样，十分奇怪的关系，按照他们两个的关系，并不应该如此，而是……
陈渊很好奇，想知道这里面发生了什么事情，想了很多，都没能想到答案。
陈初升也很好奇，问：“对啊，二弟，你到底做了什么事情？惹得商红尘如此生气，还要杀了你。”
商红尘这个女人还是很有理智的，不到迫不得已的情况下，她是不会如此做的。
一旦动手，就是和陈家彻底撕破脸，这种事情，不经过深思熟虑是不会做的。
而她，真的动手了，幸亏陈初阳避开了她的刺杀，要不然，后果不堪设想。
在他们眼里，陈初阳可不是商红尘的对手，再怎么努力也是一样，最后肯定会倒下。
陈初阳淡淡道：“也没做什么，就是……发生了一点小误会。”
接着，他说了一下发生的事情，比如他如何炼制丹药，如何让商红雪呕吐，然后发生了一系列的误会，这些事情听着都觉得很神奇，陈渊和陈初升听完之后，只有一个感觉，那就是过于荒谬，这种事情怎么可能发生？
两父子对视一眼，充满了疑惑和好奇。
“事情就是这样，你们明白了吧？”
陈渊再问：“你确定是因为那些药液的缘故？而不是你……对人家红雪做了什么？”
陈初阳无语眨眼，父亲这是不信任他。
陈渊连忙苦笑道：“不是为父不相信你，而是这件事情真的很神奇，很荒谬。”
“如果你真的喜欢红雪那个丫头，如果她真的怀孕了，这是好事，我可以上门给你提亲，促成你和红雪的好事。”
陈渊心里很开心，自己儿子要是做到这一步，自然是要迎亲的。
红雪那个丫头他很喜欢，认为很适合自己的儿子，比商红尘要适合许多。
各方面都适合，性格也好，不像是商红尘这种女强人性格，比较难搞，他也担心儿子被欺负，所以才会答应了商红尘的退婚，谁知道自己的这个儿子那么厉害，竟然可以……
陈初升张大嘴巴，看着弟弟。
“所以说，弟弟，你搞大了红雪肚子？”
怪不得人家商家全体出动找你麻烦，这种事情，换做是谁，都会如此做。
不过，他的弟弟什么时候开窍了，竟然如此……牛叉。
“没有的事情，大哥，父亲，你们不要乱想，这件事情纯粹就是子虚乌有。”
陈初阳哭笑不得，自己可是三好男人，龙蛇城最为单纯的男人，怎么会做那种事情。
他扫了一眼父亲和大哥，哪里不知道他们想什么。
“不如这样吧，你们不相信的话，我给你们炼制一锅药液。”
两父子对视一眼，默认了这件事。
于是，陈初阳开始了炼制，正好他的心里有了好的想法，可以拿父亲和大哥试验一波，谁让他们不信任自己，正好让他们……体验体验自己的强大的炼丹技术。
半个时辰后。
content_en:
"Chu Yang, what happened this time? Why are all the merchants here?"
Chen Yuan asked: "That old man Shang Yingnian came to trouble you. Did you do something?"
When receiving the news, Chen Yuan thought of many possibilities, and finally pointed to Shang Hongxue. Only if something happened to Shang Hongxue, that old guy Shang Yingnian would take action. But what they saw was the opposite. It was Shang Hongchen who was angry, not Shang Yingnian.
They didn't know what happened between Shang Yingnian and Chen Chuyang. When they arrived, the two were already friends. It was a very strange relationship. According to the relationship between the two of them, it shouldn't be like this, but...
Chen Yuan was very curious and wanted to know what was going on here. He thought a lot but couldn't think of an answer.
Chen Chusheng was also very curious and asked: "Yes, second brother, what exactly did you do? It made Shang Hongchen so angry that he even wanted to kill you."
Shang Hongchen is a very sensible woman. She would not do this unless she had no choice but to do so.
Once you take action, you will completely break up with the Chen family. This kind of thing will not be done without careful consideration.
And she really took action. Fortunately, Chen Chuyang avoided her assassination, otherwise, the consequences would have been disastrous.
In their eyes, Chen Chuyang was no match for Shang Hongchen. No matter how hard he tried, he would definitely fall in the end.
Chen Chuyang said calmly: "I didn't do anything, it's just... there was a little misunderstanding."
Then, he talked about what happened, such as how he refined the elixir, how he made Shang Hongxue vomit, and then a series of misunderstandings occurred. These things sounded very magical. After hearing this, Chen Yuan and Chen Chusheng had only one feeling, that was too ridiculous. How could such a thing happen?
The two father and son looked at each other, full of doubts and curiosity.
"That's the way it is, do you understand?"
Chen Yuan asked again: "Are you sure it's because of those medicinal liquids? It's not you...what did you do to Hongxue?"
Chen Chuyang blinked speechlessly, his father didn't trust him.
"Uh?"
Chen Yuan quickly smiled bitterly and said: "It's not that I don't believe you, but this matter is really magical and ridiculous."
"If you really like that girl Hongxue, if she is really pregnant, that is a good thing. I can come to you and propose marriage to you, so that things can get better between you and Hongxue."
Chen Yuan was very happy. If his son achieved this step, he would naturally marry him.
He liked that girl Hongxue very much and thought she was very suitable for his son, much more suitable than Shang Hongchen.
She is suitable in every aspect and has a good personality. She is not like a strong woman like Shang Hongchen, who is more difficult to deal with. He was also worried that his son would be bullied, so he agreed to break off the engagement with Shang Hongchen. Who knew that his son was so powerful that he could...
Chen Chusheng opened his mouth wide and looked at his brother.
"So, brother, you made Hongxue pregnant?"
No wonder all the merchants came out to cause trouble for you. Anyone would do this kind of thing.
However, when did his younger brother realize that he is so... awesome?
"There is no such thing, brother, father, please don't think about it. This matter is pure fiction."
Chen Chuyang didn't know whether to laugh or cry. He was a good man and the simplest man in Dragon Snake City. How could he do such a thing.
He glanced at his father and elder brother, not knowing what they were thinking.
"How about this. If you don't believe it, I will refine a pot of medicine for you."
"..."
The two father and son looked at each other and agreed to this matter.
So, Chen Chuyang started refining, and he just had a good idea in his mind. He could test it on his father and elder brother. Who made them not trust him, but just let them... experience his powerful alchemy technology.
Half an hour later.
title_en: Chapter 21 The deep love between father and son Chapter 22 Father, please take medicine
